notes: Plan prices are published as a monthly rate billed annually. The annual contract value is computed by the pricing engine as monthly x 12 and written into the quote's calculation trace; it is not stored here.
Add-on prices are published per year and are used verbatim.
Alert Credits are priced per credit, not per pack, and differ by plan (INR 28.50 on WebUptimePack, INR 19 on Enterprise Plus Web).
Basic Additional Check and Advanced Additional Check are genuinely INR 0 on Enterprise. Zero is a real published price here, not a missing value.

The Zoho Store comparison matrix renders 'undefined' for Mobile Runs and 10GB Log Forwarding rows. Those cells carry no data and are recorded as compatibility-unknown. 10GB Log Forwarding does, however, appear with a real price (INR 950/unit/year) in the add-on price grid for Professional and Enterprise.

Infrastructure and All-in-One list Lite, Professional and Enterprise at identical prices, and the store shows exactly one column for each. They are modelled as one SKU with membership in both families.
